How I Teach
My Approach
1

Past Paper Focus

Every session is built around real past papers from Cambridge and Edexcel, targeting the actual questions your IGCSE, GCSE or A Level exams will mirror.

2

Maximum Mark Techniques

I teach you exactly how Cambridge examiners want questions answered so you earn every mark available.

3

Topic Clarity First

I break down every concept until it truly makes sense. If you don't understand the topic, you can't answer the question.

4

Notes & Resources Provided

I provide comprehensive notes and study resources so you always have something to refer back to.

5

Flexible Online & In Person

One to two hour sessions, one on one or small group, online or in person in KL, arranged around your schedule.
